abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, so the counters were never placed. 'Enters the arena with N counters' happens ONCE, when it enters -- an ON_ENTER_PLAY trigger, not a continuous static, which would have kept adding counters had it run at all.

Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. The condition was COUNTER_GTE energy 1 -- it destroyed the card while it still HAD an energy counter, the exact inverse of 'when it has NONE, destroy it'. The check is one turn late: there is no state-based-action trigger to hang a continuous check on.
